description: Diplo God Mode makes Umbraco 17 developers invincible!
releaseNotes: Adds conservative administrator-only cleanup of old inactive server registrations and an optional scheduling-health AI overview. Orders active servers first and recent check-ins next. Fixes Property Search button submission and static-asset diagnostics. Shared source also supports a separate Umbraco 18 release. See the package README for compatibility and upgrade guidance.
title: Diplo.GodMode
